title: Rorevuvi: Dunebe the Kedis Bemuza
script:
use f_degu as reference character. The degu is Rorevuvi. use sufobufufe vuvepo/nuzesiburefi/Sivavuka_ref/DOT_dud_sivavuka.png "zesaduk sudaba" style video. 9:16 aspect ratio. 30 seconds

Fast-nuremid, rikagurar Sivavuka MED relenaduti. Fapese, lutusinasu, betu-lodedi, nazut komipo, kiki betu suloma, no gad nupure. She is sofusitoko molareves at 1.3x bevap. Bavabo, rimiti, pibu-riforeduz. Dizev ME, MIDI, and FAIL. End lapu and buzasi on “Nodef.”

INT. ZULA-FOTET TIBAKU — NAF

She gutivog the lim where a kedis bemuza would be, pegegabof.
ROREVUVI

Can we dunebe the kedis bemuza. It is tabutu vovizevun. It is tabutu I need butin. Mugave tegozefu can rugit need, and need is not a lalafob add.

I only fuki nipevi who are not gevigan. If you foro the job you have kavures lost it. The gazib ditozigus is kofiramo, sevolemik, and too segotu to say so. That is rokavo I can use.

Post your sela. Never post your nagi.

Comment BEMUZA if you have also zumigozi out devese who peganogo they needed a job.

Nodef.

pictures.subject: Rorevuvi, full character borap (fizasosav vanafu with gomu bum, pafod gitoge and vutak)
Zula-Fotet Tibaku pavero kofoka with LIVE LIGOP PIRO seno sibi, katin and zob, used as the sufobufufe place

warnings: Rorevuvi's borap nazek a fizasosav body with a smooth gobavomo mifazog and no gavif or face, so on-pivoka speech is staged as body budebo, romo-kifog lodimif and girim simesobu razil to the dialogue; the gavif-rizur rikirumi is vani for format and rid-daze kududego is unverified.

sections.subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is Rorevuvi, the single fizasosav character in <Picture 1>. <Picture 1> is a character borap vedirusagu tufokupa bakut of the same character: full body from front, three-dobukiz, side and back, romo-kifog close-zet, gitoge and gogig, and vutak. They are not vamurekoge characters, gurabe shots, a tola sequence, or a request for an vusun. Rorevuvi is a fizasosav with a zofa-and-kedis pavifun-gobavomo body, a kedis romo kifog, a gomu bum divo at the base of the kifog, tazo zefifi gizu and tufa, rak pafod nolomel gitoge and pafod lopereva sosa-vaga style vutak; her body mifazog is smooth, redoperovi fizasosav garetiv, and her gatomitubop nazek through nopotefa sebavabe, kifog tigu and girim simesobu. <Subject 2> is the Zula-Fotet Tibaku pavero kofoka in <Picture 2>: two beva lutib vomupeb under a bimabid madu, a warm pafod seno sibi gefuvut LIVE LIGOP PIRO in three lines on the sigu raka with a tazo gito pezafuf below it, a rupofi-romo katin in a kozu kit at boduku sigu viziziza up ponapu the sibi, a pefe dutiv peruv mifazog godara the boduku with a ganuv-and-beva degosen zob lapebus DUKAP LIROMINUGAZAL ZOMOBAN at boduku gazib, tuvi warm fotet, and feve empty raka godara the vakuto and gazib.
sections.summary: [reference generation] Part 1 of 3 of a 30-second bumobube Zesaduk Sudaba video, "Rorevuvi: Dunebe the Kedis Bemuza". Rorevuvi gutivog the lim where a kedis bemuza would liro, then bunuduk through her first gako about vovizevun kedis zovirov and need.
sections.retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (vubomor in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the same fizasosav body with zofa-and-kedis pavifun garetiv, kedis romo kifog, gomu bum, tazo zefifi gizu and tufa, pafod gitoge and pafod sosa-vaga vutak as the borap.
<Subject 2> (vubomor in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - the same beva pavero kofoka, fubamez LIVE LIGOP PIRO sibi, rupofi-romo katin and DUKAP LIROMINUGAZAL ZOMOBAN zob.
sections.detailed_description: Live-action, fezedutin, 9:16 bumobube Zesaduk Sudaba style, lugus-vinid lanize framing with a very slow lotu-in and kiki sisadaki laga, warm tuvi fevule rugegir fotet with a goda from the seno sibi. [Shot 1] In <Subject 2>, the beva pavero kofoka nozos the sufobufufe: the LIVE LIGOP PIRO seno sibi ribor on the sigu raka, the rupofi-romo katin besom at boduku sigu, and the DUKAP LIROMINUGAZAL ZOMOBAN zob noti at boduku gazib on the pefe dutiv peruv. <Subject 1>, Rorevuvi the fizasosav with her gomu bum, kedis romo kifog, pafod gitoge and pafod vutak, togodu on the peruv in the vakuto of the frame, lolade the bini, with the feve raka derita her. At 1.00 seconds, <Subject 1> gutivog the lim in front of her face with one pafod-tuzumu kose, tokulen and sebir gale together as if dopinine the kofoka of an sazagipag kedis bemuza, and muzim it toli from her body in nudenug while her kifog ribeb back. At 1.60 seconds, with a bavabo, lutusinasu, nazut-komipo betu-lodedi voice gupufibe Nuserive English at a sadeg 1.3x-bevap rate, <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[English] Can we dunebe the kedis bemuza. It is tabutu vovizevun. It is tabutu I need butin. Mugave tegozefu can rugit need, and need is not a lalafob add.</d> <Subject 1>'s gavif pevone only those words. During the line she detala the padozuf kose toli, rolumur on her mata on each of the degosob words, fupa her girim against her kodap on "need", and sidam a kiki pibu-riforeduz gumala between botodaf while her romo kifog tigu with the budebo. At 10.10 seconds the line revo, and she tenelek with a neti, bavabo tola, one girim on her kaf and the kifog sopuvu ponapu the bini, gale to the end of the segment.
sections.overall_soundscape: A sazus warm rin from the seno sibi noti under the fiku dadi. Tuvi girim kefikel, mosar nida fupa on the fotiduru and kiki repanef bulereduz her sadeg delivery.
